title: Stone Game III
description: Alice and Bob take turns picking 1, 2, or 3 stones from the end of the array. The player with the most points wins. Determine the outcome for Alice.

steps.note: Pick 1 stone (value 2), res = 2 - dp[2] = 2 - 3 = -1. Pick 2 stones (value 2+3=5), res = max(-1, 5 - dp[3]) = 5
Pick 1 stone (1 - dp[1] = 1 - 5 = -4). Pick 2 stones (1+2 - dp[2] = 3 - 5 = -2). Pick 3 stones (1+2+3 - dp[3] = 6). Max is 6.
